scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @matra/server" "npm run dev -w @matra/web"
scripts.build: node scripts/fetch-models.mjs && npm run build -w @matra/web && node scripts/audit-web-build.mjs
scripts.stack:up: docker compose --env-file .stack/stack.env build app && docker compose --env-file .stack/stack.env up -d && echo "Matra: http://localhost:8080  (Server view: /inspector)"
scripts.stack:reset: docker compose --env-file .stack/stack.env down -v; node scripts/stack-init.mjs && npm run stack:up
